summary: Comprehensive testing of Step Navigation Blocking feature on NETRA ERP Onboarding form - ALL 8 tests PASSED. Validated that form navigation is properly blocked when mandatory fields are missing or invalid.

test_1_empty_fields_block_navigation.description: Click 'Save & Next' with empty fields blocks navigation
test_1_empty_fields_block_navigation.behavior: Form remains on Step 1, shows validation toast

test_2_validation_order.description: Validation checks fields in order - finds missing mandatory field before format validation
test_2_validation_order.behavior: Sequential validation - checks presence first, then format

test_3_invalid_pan_blocks_navigation.description: Invalid PAN format blocks navigation with specific error
test_3_invalid_pan_blocks_navigation.behavior: Form remains on Step 1, shows PAN validation error

test_4_step_indicator_blocks_forward.description: Clicking step 2 indicator when step 1 is incomplete shows error
test_4_step_indicator_blocks_forward.toast_message: Please complete the current step before proceeding
test_4_step_indicator_blocks_forward.behavior: Cannot skip steps by clicking step indicators

test_5_valid_step_allows_navigation.description: Form advances to Step 2 after completing all Step 1 fields correctly
test_5_valid_step_allows_navigation.behavior: Moved to Education step after valid Personal Details

test_6_previous_button_always_works.description: Previous button allows going back without validation
test_6_previous_button_always_works.behavior: Can freely navigate backward through steps

test_7_work_experience_required.description: Step 3 (Work Experience) blocks navigation without entries
test_7_work_experience_required.toast_message: Please add at least one work experience entry
test_7_work_experience_required.behavior: Cannot proceed to Bank Details without work experience

test_8_work_experience_allows_navigation.description: Step 3 allows navigation after adding work experience entry
test_8_work_experience_allows_navigation.behavior: Moved to Bank Details step after adding work experience
